name: Nurture Well Industries Limited
about: Nurture Well Industries Limited trades in food products in India and internationally. The company operates through Manufacturing of Food Products and Traded Goods segments. It also manufactures and distributes biscuits and cookies under the RICHLITE, FUNTREAT, and CANBERRA brands, as well as engages in the business of organic and inorganic food products, bakery products, and other processed food items. The company was formerly known as Integrated Industries Limited and changed its name to Nurture Well Industries Limited in January 2026. Nurture Well Industries Limited was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Noida, India.
